title: Answer: no account of time, which enters as the continuity of the narrative self

statements.text: Predictive processing, in Seth's account, takes no position on what time is. Time enters through the self: the narrative self is the experience of being a continuous and distinctive person over time, built from autobiographical memories, and it is one more part of the brain's best guess about the causes of its signals.
statements.scope: the essay The hard problem of consciousness is a distraction from the real one (2016)

sources.quote: The narrative self is where the 'I' comes in, as the experience of being a continuous and distinctive person over time, built from a rich set of autobiographical memories.
What we see is the brain's 'best guess' of what's out there.
